# Code review: OIDC MFA step-up (`d1f57d81b...030dec0f6`)

**Ready to open the PR.** Nothing blocks it: no security holes, no correctness bugs and no broken callers. Six small (P3) items are left, and none of them change behaviour in a way users would notice unless clocks drift.

Mode: range review, committed changes only · 26 files, +1170 −69 · the untracked `.claude/skills/code-conventions/` was out of scope · read-only, so no tests were run.

| | |
|---|---|
| Verdict | Ready to open |
| Score | about 94/100 (approximate, see "What this review did not cover") |
| What held it down | Conventions (4 P3), then bugs and DRY (1 P3 each) |
| Fix first | F1, the zero-tolerance clock-skew check in `hasFreshMfa` |
| Adjudicated | 12 of 12 · 6 confirmed · 2 weakened · 4 refuted · 3 promoted from deferrals |

## Scores by area

| Area | Score | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Conventions | ~80 | F4, F6, F7, F8; F3 and F5 weakened |
| Bugs | ~95 | F1 |
| DRY | ~95 | F9 |
| Security | 100 | Clean (see below) |
| Regression | 100 | The one finding was refuted |
| Testing | 100 | Thorough coverage; its test-style deferrals are counted under conventions |
| Architecture | 100 | Clean |
| KISS | 100 | Clean |
| Performance | n/a | No upstream calls, caching or loops added |

## What this review did not cover
- No tests, lint or typecheck were run.
- The score is a simplified deduction, not the full `review-score` computation.
- Adjudication used one refuter agent per finding plus my own checks, not the full validator-and-refuter pair.

## Findings (all P3, worth a ticket or a quick fix)

**F1 · bugs · `src/modules/auth/domain/entities/auth-payload.entity.ts:106`**
`hasFreshMfa` rejects any `mfa_verified_at` that is in the future, with no tolerance at all (`ageSeconds >= 0`). The stamp is written from one gateway instance's clock (`src/modules/auth/oidc/routes/oidc-auth.service.ts:144`) and may be checked on another. If the second clock is just 1 second behind, the user gets a 403 `elevation_required` straight after a successful step-up. The repo already handles this kind of drift with `auth.clockSkewSeconds` (`src/modules/siwe/domain/entities/siwe-message.entity.ts:53-78`).
→ Allow `ageSeconds >= -clockSkewSeconds`, and add a test for a 1–5 second skew (the current test only uses 10,000 s).

**F4 · conventions · `src/config/entities/configuration.ts:481`**
The new `mfaStepUp` flag has no comment naming an owner and a removal condition, which `docs/agents/configuration-and-flags.md:51-57` requires. That doc says the first flag to land sets the example.
→ Add one line, e.g. owner WA-2725, remove once WA-2852 ships.

**F6 · conventions · `src/modules/auth/routes/guards/elevation.guard.spec.ts:34-45`**
`oidcPayload()` and `siwePayload()` are hand-written literals. They repeat `oidcAuthPayloadDtoBuilder` / `siweAuthPayloadDtoBuilder`, which the rest of this PR uses, and break the builders-only rule in `docs/agents/testing.md:70`.

**F7 · conventions · `src/modules/auth/oidc/routes/oidc-auth.service.spec.ts:415,426`**
Two newly added lines hit known review remarks: `buildAuth0Token(amr) as never` (R-002) and `signToken.mock.calls[0][0]` (R-005). Use a typed mock value and `toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ mfa_verified_at: … }), …)`.

**F8 · conventions · `src/modules/spaces/routes/members/members.controller.ts:88-97`, and all 12 gated routes**
The existing `@ApiForbiddenResponse` descriptions don't mention the new 403 `elevation_required`, even though clients are expected to match on it. The repo's example lists every cause of a 403 (`src/modules/relay/routes/relay.controller.ts:84-87`, rule at `docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md:93-97`).

**F9 · DRY · `src/modules/auth/domain/entities/auth-payload.entity.ts:102`, `src/modules/auth/oidc/routes/oidc-auth.service.ts:144`**
Both lines compute `Math.floor(Date.now() / 1_000)` inline. The repo already has `toSecondsTimestamp` in `src/domain/common/utils/time.ts:9-11`, and `oidc-auth.service.ts` already imports another helper from that file.

**Weakened, still worth knowing:**
- **F3 · `src/config/entities/configuration.ts:61`**: `AUTH_ELEVATION_WINDOW_SECONDS` is missing from `RootConfigurationSchema` (AGENTS.md non-negotiable 7), unlike its sibling `AUTH_STATE_TTL_MILLISECONDS` at `configuration.schema.ts:120`. It was weakened because three other `AUTH_*` numbers were already missing before this PR. The effect: a bad value becomes `NaN`, and every gated route then returns 403 instead of the app failing at boot. Fails closed, but it is a loud outage. Adding `z.coerce.number().int().min(1).optional()` would cost one line.
- **F5 · `src/modules/auth/routes/guards/elevation.guard.ts:75`**: the guard throws `ForbiddenException` rather than `HttpExceptionNoLog`, which `src/modules/auth/AGENTS.md:10` asks for on expected rejections. It was weakened because the module never uses `HttpExceptionNoLog` (see `auth.service.ts:110`, `token-expiration.utils.ts:14`). This is a stale doc more than a new deviation.

## Ruled out
- **REG-001**: the claim that `members.controller.e2e-spec.ts:120-129` breaks because `checkGuardIsApplied` throws on `[AuthGuard, ElevationGuard]`. Refuted: `tsconfig.json` targets es2024, so class methods are non-enumerable. `Object.values(MembersController.prototype)` returns `[]` and the loop never runs, before or after this PR. That test has always been hollow; it's a separate cleanup below.
- **F2**: the builder's default `mfa_verified_at` hides the "no MFA at login" case. Refuted: `src/modules/spaces/routes/elevation.integration.spec.ts:244-314` sets it to `undefined` and asserts 403 on every gated route.
- **F10**: the ACR URI literal is repeated in specs. Refuted: it is the value under test, which the builders rule exempts (`testing.md:70`).
- **F11**: the inline options type duplicates `AuthorizationUrlOptions`. Refuted: it deliberately keeps `connection` typed as `OidcConnection` rather than `string`.

## Security: checked and clean
- The guard always runs after `AuthGuard`: either in the same `@UseGuards` array, or with `AuthGuard` at class level (`spaces.controller.ts:50`, `space-safes.controller.ts:43`).
- The `elevate` flag is only trusted after the state matches the one-time cookie (`oidc-auth.controller.ts:225`).
- The `amr` claim comes from the verified Auth0 token, and `mfa_verified_at` exists only inside a signed JWT.
- The SIWE exemption is documented, relies on OIDC and wallet accounts never merging, and is tested.

## Worth tidying (no score impact)
1. `src/__tests__/util/check-guard.ts:8` calls `expect` inside `.some()`. Together with `Object.values(prototype)` being empty, "should require authentication for every endpoint" checks nothing in 10 spec files. Iterating `Object.getOwnPropertyNames(prototype)` and using a plain boolean predicate would make those tests real. Expect some of them to fail on routes guarded only at class level.

Your call on the cleanup: **fix**, **ticket** or **skip**. This was a read-only run, so nothing was changed, posted or ticketed.
